surface_origin_meaning: Tray underside; set surface world glTF Y to floatSurfaceY for float variant, do not resize or move its children independently.

parts.name: SV3_TRAY_PLATE
parts.note: Open central bore and two cable-clearance holes. Not a weather seal or released structural plate.

parts.name: SV3_OPEN_BOTTOM_SKIRT
parts.note: Open-bottom skirt, no displaced sealed-air volume credited. Ventilation and splash ingress unresolved.

parts.name: SV3_PANEL_A
parts.note: Victron SPM040401200 purchased envelope. 3.1 kg vendor nominal, not density-derived. Frame, cells, clamp zones and terminal positions unknown.

parts.name: SV3_WEDGE_A_1
parts.note: Solid custom wedge rail with a planar face tangent to the exact tilted panel underside; attachment/clamp design open.

parts.name: SV3_WEDGE_A_2
parts.note: Solid custom wedge rail with a planar face tangent to the exact tilted panel underside; attachment/clamp design open.

parts.name: SV3_PANEL_B
parts.note: Victron SPM040401200 purchased envelope. 3.1 kg vendor nominal, not density-derived. Frame, cells, clamp zones and terminal positions unknown.

parts.name: SV3_WEDGE_B_1
parts.note: Solid custom wedge rail with a planar face tangent to the exact tilted panel underside; attachment/clamp design open.

parts.name: SV3_WEDGE_B_2
parts.note: Solid custom wedge rail with a planar face tangent to the exact tilted panel underside; attachment/clamp design open.

parts.name: SV3_HUB_HAMMOND_1550WJ
parts.note: Flat Hammond 1550WJ overall envelope only. Vendor tapered interior, gasket, bosses, fasteners and actual mass unknown; do not treat this solid as metal or sealed buoyancy.

parts.name: SV3_HUB_CARRIER
parts.note: Shelf supports hub underside; two hanger tabs touch tray and clear shade ends. Welds/bolts, retention and loads not released.

parts.name: SV3_SHADE_ROOF
parts.note: Inherited custom 375 x 275 x 1.5 mm shade roof and 75 mm hub gap. Directly under tray/panels now; no shade or thermal performance transferred.

parts.name: SV3_SHADE_HANGER_1
parts.note: Custom candidate; joints and physical suitability unqualified.

parts.name: SV3_SHADE_HANGER_2
parts.note: Custom candidate; joints and physical suitability unqualified.

parts.name: SV3_SINK_OCCUPANCY_NOT_FINS
parts.note: Wakefield 125460/XX4559 full occupancy, NOT solid metal or dimensioned fins. Beside the flat hub, no designed rear-base contact, no installed thermal or mass result.

parts.name: SV3_SINK_OUTLET_AIR_ALLOCATION
parts.note: Open-air reservation above vertical sink occupancy. Skirt changes ventilation; this clearance is not a convection result.

parts.name: SV3_CROSS_BOLT_ALLOCATION_1
parts.note: Unpopulated cross-bolt space. Both socket and pole have larger clearance bores; no fastener/head/thread/locking design claimed.

parts.name: SV3_CROSS_BOLT_ALLOCATION_2
parts.note: Unpopulated cross-bolt space. Both socket and pole have larger clearance bores; no fastener/head/thread/locking design claimed.

parts.name: SV3_MAST_SOCKET
parts.note: Custom candidate; joints and physical suitability unqualified.

parts.name: SV3_POLE_60MM
parts.note: Hollow, unsealed 60 mm pole. Length is water depth plus freeboard; ends at footing plate top. No embedment, foundation or load capacity inferred.

parts.name: SV3_SEABED_FOOTING_PLATE
parts.note: Seabed-top plate allocation represented as custom physical plate. Not an engineered anchor, deadweight or embedment design.

parts.name: SV3_CABLE_ROUTE_ALLOCATION_A
parts.note: Unterminated route stub through tray clearance hole, not actual panel junction/gland geometry or a full harness. Inherited 56 mm bend allowance remains unresolved at ends.

parts.name: SV3_CABLE_ROUTE_ALLOCATION_B
parts.note: Unterminated route stub through tray clearance hole, not actual panel junction/gland geometry or a full harness. Inherited 56 mm bend allowance remains unresolved at ends.

parts.name: SV3_FLOAT_COLLAR
parts.note: Closed-cell dry foam assumption, not a sourced buoy. Tray bears on collar top; skirt fits open centre. Conditional mass scenario sets waterline, no stability or wave result.

geometry_rule: Source BRep is the record. No Blender resizing; use source transforms, part STEP hashes and per-part binary GLB bounds/volumes. Keep allocation materials visibly provisional.
rights: Vendor dimension provenance retained; no blanket licence or public redistribution authorization. No new downloads.
